name: shunge-selfmedia
description: Shunge's own self-media expert. Currently covers Xiaohongshu notes end to end (topic, title, body, cover, images, compliance check, comment replies) reading the owner's account card first; other platforms are added by the same three-step pattern.

displayDescription.en: Produces Xiaohongshu notes from topic to cover and replies to comments following the owner's account card; WeChat Channels, Douyin, Kuaishou, WeChat MP and Toutiao are added on the same pattern.
